This site collects two write-ups on predicting player churn in the
[World of Warcraft Avatar History](https://qualinet.github.io/databases/world_of_warcraft_avatar_history_dataset/)
dataset with [skrub](https://skrub-data.org/) Data Ops.

:::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-3 .mb-3}
### [Blog post](draft.html)

A step-by-step walk-through of the pipeline: from the raw heartbeat logs to a
monthly churn model, covering the data preparation, the custom time-aware
splitter and the skrub Data Op that ties everything together.

[Read the post](draft.html){.btn .btn-primary}
:::

### [Slides](skrub-dataops.html)

The talk version: what skrub Data Ops are, why they matter on a real project,
and the pain points they solve, illustrated on the same churn pipeline.

[Open the slides](skrub-dataops.html){.btn .btn-primary}

## Data and code

The pipeline, the notebooks and the raw data preparation live in the

report of the Data Op is available
[here](reports/execution_report/index.html){target="_blank"}.
